spec.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS total_events
FROM event_intelligence.processed_events

WITH latest_incidents AS
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status
    FROM outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT countIf(latest_status = 'CLOSED') AS completed_outages
FROM latest_incidents

WITH latest_incidents AS
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status,
        argMax(duration_minutes, received_at) AS duration_minutes
    FROM outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT round(
    avgIf(
        duration_minutes,
        latest_status = 'CLOSED'
        AND duration_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),
    2
) AS avg_restoration_minutes
FROM latest_incidents

WITH latest_incidents AS
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status,
        argMax(duration_minutes, received_at) AS duration_minutes
    FROM outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT maxIf(
    duration_minutes,
    latest_status = 'CLOSED'
    AND duration_minutes IS NOT NULL
) AS longest_outage_minutes
FROM latest_incidents

WITH latest_incidents AS
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(msn, received_at) AS msn,
        argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status
    FROM outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
),
meter_counts AS
(
    SELECT
        msn,
        count() AS outage_count
    FROM latest_incidents
    WHERE latest_status = 'CLOSED'
    GROUP BY msn
)
SELECT countIf(outage_count > 1) AS repeated_outage_meters
FROM meter_counts

WITH latest_incidents AS
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(dtr_name, received_at) AS dtr_name,
        argMax(feeder_name, received_at) AS feeder_name,
        argMax(substation_name, received_at) AS substation_name,
        argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status,
        argMax(duration_minutes, received_at) AS duration_minutes
    FROM outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT
    substation_name AS substation,
    feeder_name AS feeder,
    dtr_name AS dtr,
    count() AS completed_outages,
    round(avg(duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_restoration_minutes,
    max(duration_minutes) AS longest_outage_minutes
FROM latest_incidents
WHERE latest_status = 'CLOSED'
  AND duration_minutes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    substation_name,
    feeder_name,
    dtr_name
ORDER BY
    completed_outages DESC,
    avg_restoration_minutes DESC

SELECT
    candidate_rank AS "Rank",
    unknown_msn AS "Unknown Meter",
    candidate_feeder AS "Candidate Feeder",
    candidate_substation AS "Substation",
    supporting_meter_count AS "Supporting Meters",
    round(cooccurrence_score, 4) AS "Outage Co-occurrence",
    round(distance_km, 2) AS "Distance (km)",
    round(proximity_score, 4) AS "Geo Proximity",
    round(confidence, 4) AS "Confidence",
    recommendation AS "Recommendation"
FROM topology_inference_results
WHERE inference_id = (
    SELECT argMax(inference_id, received_at)
    FROM topology_inference_results
)
ORDER BY candidate_rank ASC

SELECT
    candidate_feeder AS "Top Suggested Feeder"
FROM topology_inference_results
WHERE candidate_rank = 1
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    round(confidence * 100, 2) AS "Confidence %"
FROM topology_inference_results
WHERE candidate_rank = 1
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    count() AS value
FROM anomaly_detection_results
WHERE prediction = 'ANOMALY'

SELECT count() AS validation_failures
FROM event_intelligence.processed_events
WHERE validation_status = 'FAIL'

SELECT
    window_start AS "Window",
    msn AS "Meter",
    event_count_15m AS "Events",
    round(avg_voltage_15m, 2) AS "Avg Voltage",
    round(voltage_range_15m, 2) AS "Voltage Range",
    round(anomaly_score, 6) AS "Anomaly Score",
    severity AS "Severity"
FROM anomaly_detection_results
WHERE prediction = 'ANOMALY'
ORDER BY anomaly_score DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    prediction AS "Prediction",
    count() AS "Windows"
FROM anomaly_detection_results
GROUP BY prediction
ORDER BY Windows DESC

SELECT
    concat(
        msn,
        ' | ',
        formatDateTime(
            parseDateTimeBestEffort(window_start),
            '%m-%d %H:%i'
        )
    ) AS "Meter Window",
    round(anomaly_score, 6) AS "Anomaly Score"
FROM anomaly_detection_results
WHERE prediction = 'ANOMALY'
ORDER BY anomaly_score DESC

SELECT count() AS active_outages
FROM
(
    SELECT incident_id
    FROM event_intelligence.outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
    HAVING countIf(incident_status = 'CLOSED') = 0
)

SELECT count() AS restored_outages
FROM
(
    SELECT incident_id
    FROM event_intelligence.outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
    HAVING countIf(incident_status = 'CLOSED') > 0
)

SELECT round(avg(duration_minutes), 1) AS avg_outage_duration_minutes
FROM
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        max(duration_minutes) AS duration_minutes
    FROM event_intelligence.outage_incident_events
    WHERE incident_status = 'CLOSED'
    GROUP BY incident_id
)

SELECT
    incident_id,
    any(msn) AS msn,
    'CLOSED' AS incident_status,
    max(start_ts) AS start_ts,
    max(end_ts) AS end_ts,
    max(duration_minutes) AS duration_minutes,
    any(feeder_name) AS feeder_name,
    any(substation_name) AS substation_name
FROM event_intelligence.outage_incident_events
WHERE incident_status = 'CLOSED'
GROUP BY incident_id
ORDER BY max(received_at) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT count() AS currently_unresolved_over_5min
FROM
(
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status
    FROM outage_incident_events
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
WHERE latest_status = 'UNRESOLVED'

SELECT
    incident_id,
    argMax(msn, received_at) AS msn,
    argMax(dtr_name, received_at) AS dtr_name,
    argMax(feeder_name, received_at) AS feeder_name,
    argMax(substation_name, received_at) AS substation_name,
    argMax(start_ts, received_at) AS outage_started_at,
    argMax(incident_status, received_at) AS latest_status,
    max(received_at) AS last_update
FROM outage_incident_events
GROUP BY incident_id
HAVING latest_status = 'UNRESOLVED'
ORDER BY last_update DESC
